housing.summary: Renting in Paris typically requires a full dossier (photo ID, proof of income around three times the rent, employment contract, guarantor). Unfurnished leases (bail vide) run three years and furnished leases (bail meuble) one year. The security deposit is capped by law at one month's rent for unfurnished and two months for furnished.

banking.summary: Opening a French bank account requires proof of identity and proof of address. If a bank refuses, the 'droit au compte' guarantees basic banking services through an institution designated by the Banque de France.
banking.required_docs: Valid photo ID (passport or carte nationale d'identite), proof of address (justificatif de domicile), and generally proof of residence or employment.
banking.banks_named: BNP Paribas, Societe Generale, Credit Agricole, LCL, La Banque Postale

schools.summary: Paris public schools are overseen by the Academie de Paris. Enrolment (inscription scolaire) for maternelle and elementaire is handled by the Mairie de Paris, and directly by the establishment for college and lycee. International and bilingual sections and private international schools are also available.
schools.curricula: French national curriculum (Education nationale); international sections and private international schools also available.

legal_admin.summary: New residents complete residence and registration formalities. Non-EU nationals must validate their long-stay visa or hold a titre de sejour; administrative procedures are centralised on service-public.fr.
legal_admin.registration_step: Validate the long-stay visa (VLS-TS) with the OFII within three months of arrival; non-EU nationals apply for or renew a titre de sejour at the prefecture.

tax_finance.summary: Residents declare income to the Direction generale des Finances publiques via impots.gouv.fr. A tax number (numero fiscal) is required to create an online account and file a declaration.

transport.summary: Paris and the Ile-de-France region are served by an integrated network of metro, RER, bus and tram, accessed with the Navigo pass. Fares and passes are set by Ile-de-France Mobilites.
transport.network_name: Ile-de-France Mobilites (metro, RER, bus and tram operated by RATP and SNCF); Navigo pass
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences are valid; non-EU licences may be exchanged (echange de permis) subject to reciprocity agreements, generally within one year of establishing residence.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register with Assurance Maladie (CPAM) to obtain a social security number and carte Vitale; residents are covered under PUMa (protection universelle maladie).
